title: Design Snake Game
goal: Simulate a snake on a grid that grows when it eats food, and report the score after every move, or -1 when the game ends.
strategy: Keep the snake body as a queue with the head first. Each move adds a new head; the tail is removed unless the snake eats, and a move into the body or off the grid ends the game.

phasePurposes.start: The snake starts at the top-left cell with length 1.
phasePurposes.move: The head steps into the next cell, and the grid bounds are checked before anything else.
phasePurposes.eat: Food makes the snake grow, so the tail stays and the score increases.
phasePurposes.slide: Without food the tail moves up, which keeps the length the same.
phasePurposes.lose: Leaving the grid or hitting the body ends the game with -1.
phasePurposes.done: Every move has produced its result.

edgeCases: A move into the cell the tail just vacated is allowed
Eating into the tail cell is a collision
The game ends on the first losing move, and later moves are not played
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
